# Projects

Selected topics and projects from my work in computational genomics, bioinformatics
infrastructure and scientific software. They reflect different parts of
my work, from analysing biological data to developing computational
tools and connecting them into research workflows.


## Epigenomics & computational genomics

::: {.project-track}

::: {.project-entry}

### Gene regulation & biomarkers

<div class="project-tags">
DNA methylation · eCLIP-seq · RIP-seq · Translational research
</div>

Collaborative research investigating mechanisms of gene regulation
and potential molecular biomarkers in different biomedical contexts.

The work includes DNA methylation profiling using microarrays, as well
as eCLIP-seq and RIP-seq analyses to investigate post-transcriptional
regulation through interactions between RNA molecules and RNA-binding
proteins.

<div class="project-links">

[LHX1 study →](https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S1600613524006877)

[Rett syndrome study →](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s12943-023-01809-8)

[METTL1 study →](https://www.mdpi.com/1422-0067/24/2/1453)

</div>

:::


::: {.project-entry}

### Hematopoietic epigenomics and hematological malignancies

<div class="project-tags">
DNA methylation · WGBS · BLUEPRINT · Integrative genomics
</div>

Research into DNA methylation and epigenomic regulation during normal
hematopoietic differentiation and in hematological malignancies,
primarily within the BLUEPRINT project.

The work combined large-scale whole-genome bisulfite sequencing with
other genomic and epigenomic data to investigate normal differentiation
and disease-associated changes.

<div class="project-links">

[Immune-system DNA methylation →](https://www.cell.com/cell-reports/fulltext/S2211-1247(16)31474-7?_returnURL=https%3A%2F%2Flinkinghub.elsevier.com%2Fretrieve%2Fpii%2FS2211124716314747%3Fshowall%3Dtrue)

[B-cell differentiation methylome →](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26053498/)

[Multiple myeloma epigenome →](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25644835/)

</div>

:::

:::


## Bioinformatics infrastructure

::: {.project-track}

::: {.project-entry}

### Building a bioinformatics core facility

<div class="project-tags">
Research infrastructure · Team · Processes · Reproducibility
</div>

Building the Bioinformatics Unit at the Josep Carreras Leukaemia
Research Institute involved more than establishing an analysis service.

The work included developing working practices for project intake and
data management, reproducible analysis workflows, computational
infrastructure, documentation and training, while supporting multiple
research groups and projects.

It shaped how I think about bioinformatics as an ecosystem connecting
people, data, software and infrastructure.

:::


::: {.project-entry}

### Research computing and data workflows

<div class="project-tags">
HPC · Data management · Workflow integration · Research computing
</div>

Development of an integrated computational environment supporting DNA
methylation array analysis, connecting metadata capture, reproducible
analysis workflows, HPC computing and the organization of analysis
results.

The system brought together **BioForms** for structured metadata
capture, **EPipe** for reproducible analysis, HPC scheduling and
**MethylationDB** for organizing and accessing DNA methylation data.

[Read more in Building Bioinformatics →](https://angemerkel.github.io/building-bioinformatics/)

:::

:::


## Scientific software & workflows

::: {.project-track .project-track-software}

::: {.project-entry}

### EPipe

<div class="project-tags">
DNA methylation arrays · Reproducible workflows · R
</div>

Development of a reproducible modular workflow for analysing and reporting
Illumina DNA methylation array data.

EPipe was developed within the bioinformatics core facility to
standardize frequently requested analyses while retaining the
flexibility needed for individual research projects.

<div class="project-links">

[GitHub repository →](https://github.com/ijcBIT/epipe)

</div>

:::


::: {.project-entry}

### BioForms

<div class="project-tags">
Metadata · Ontologies · Data capture · Research workflows
</div>

Development of a tool for structured capture of research metadata and
project information.

I defined the scientific and functional requirements, including the
metadata structure and ontologies, and worked with the software engineer
in my team on the development and refinement of the tool.

BioForms was designed to make metadata collection part of the research
workflow and to provide structured information that could be used by
downstream computational processes.

<div class="project-links">

[GitHub repository →](https://github.com/ijcBIT/BioForms)

</div>

:::


::: {.project-entry}

### MethylationDB

<div class="project-tags">
DNA methylation · Data platform · Data visualization · Research infrastructure
</div>

Development of a platform for accessing, exploring and visualizing
DNA methylation data and analysis results.

I supervised the redevelopment of an existing system through two major
releases, working with software engineers, laboratory staff and researchers
on the restructuring of the application and the redesign of its backend
and frontend.

MethylationDB was designed as a user-facing platform for the genomics
core facility, allowing researchers to access and explore their data
and compare results against a large reference collection derived from
TCGA datasets.

:::


::: {.project-entry}

### gemBS & WGBS analysis

<div class="project-tags">
WGBS · Analysis workflows · R · Downstream analysis
</div>

Work on computational workflows for processing and analysing
whole-genome bisulfite sequencing data.

I used gemBS extensively for large-scale WGBS analysis, contributing
testing and feedback during its development, and developed a local R
package for downstream analysis and exploration of gemBS results.

gemBS was subsequently adopted for WGBS processing by ENCODE and has
continued to be evaluated in large-scale benchmarking of DNA methylation
analysis workflows.

<div class="project-links">

[gemBS publication →](https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/article/35/5/737/5077236)

[ENCODE WGBS pipeline →](https://www.encodeproject.org/data-standards/wgbs-encode4/)

[Pipeline Olympics →](https://academic.oup.com/nar/article/53/19/gkaf970/8294356)

</div>

:::
